featureWindows.fullSeason: All Season N records aggregated by canonical player and position.
featureWindows.lateSeason: Mean of the final two active observations available in Season N.
featureWindows.earlyVsLateGrowth: Final-two mean minus the preceding-two mean, using only the final four active observations in Season N.

composite.reason: Two historical transitions support signal validation, not a stable multi-signal coefficient model.

currentWatchlist.reason: No composite was justified; current-player scoring was intentionally skipped.
